subject: Mbappe double beats Barcelona in El Clasico as Mourinho celebrates on his knees
title: Mbappe, seven offsides, one Clasico

lines.vo: Mbappe was flagged offside seven times, and he still won El Clasico.
Seven: the most by any player in a major European league in six years. The linesman and Mbappe are on first-name terms.
He scored a deflected opener in the forty-first minute. Then the winner in the eighty-seventh.
Real Madrid won two-one at Camp Nou, their first win there in three years. That ended Barcelona's nine-game La Liga winning run.
Camavinga's run set up the winner. Barcelona stay top, Atletico two points back.
Mourinho complained that VAR did not check a challenge. Then he celebrated by sliding on his knees.

lines.vo: Seven offsides, two goals, one knee slide. That is El Clasico in one line.
